title: matterbridge-obs
description: Bridges open bridge server DataPoints tagged matter:<devicetype> into Matter (Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings)

obsApiUrl.title: OBS API URL
obsApiUrl.description: Base URL of the open bridge server REST API, e.g. http://localhost:8080

obsApiKey.title: OBS API Key
obsApiKey.description: API key created in the OBS Admin GUI (Settings → API Keys)

mqttHost.title: MQTT Host
mqttHost.description: Hostname/IP of the Mosquitto broker OBS uses

mqttUsername.title: MQTT Username
mqttUsername.description: MQTT service account username (matches OBS's mqtt.username config)

mqttPassword.title: MQTT Password
mqttPassword.description: MQTT service account password (matches OBS's mqtt.password config)

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin (development only)

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
